item.description:
Ask your Memory — semantic search

Aura's search is now semantic and on-device. It reads what you actually saved — text in screenshots (OCR), the body of articles behind your links, video titles & descriptions — and ranks your library by meaning, so “that documentary about money” or “everything I saved about investing” just works.

  • Natural-language search — hybrid keyword + on-device embeddings (NaturalLanguage), 100% local.
  • AI answer — on Apple Silicon with Apple Intelligence, press Return to get a short written answer grounded in your results (Foundation Models).
  • Richer indexing — image OCR, link article text, PDF text, and YouTube/Vimeo metadata.
  • Automatic updates — Aura now updates itself (this is the first build with it).
